subject: Request to move demo — VP travel window conflicts
messages:
From: Alex Brown <alex.brown@skyrise.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Lang <tom.lang@skyrise.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Need to move Thursday demo — VP travel conflict

Hi Grace,

Quick heads-up: Tom (our VP of Data & Platforms) was planning to join the demo this Thursday at 11am ET, but his travel schedule changed and he'll be in transit during that slot. He specifically asked to be present for the executive overview (first ~20 minutes) only.

Can we shift the session to a time when Tom can attend the opening? Our team is available the following options:
- Friday 30 Apr, 3:00–4:00pm ET (preferred)
- Tuesday 4 May, 10:00–11:00am PT

If neither works, we could keep the original time and have Tom join for the first 20 minutes remotely from the airport (not ideal). Please let me know what works on your side so we can lock it in.

Thanks — appreciate the flexibility.

Alex
Alex Brown
Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships
Skyrise Analytics
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Alex Brown <alex.brown@skyrise.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need to move Thursday demo — VP travel conflict

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the note and the windows. We can absolutely accommodate an exec-first flow. Tentative availability from our side:

Option A: Fri, 30 Apr, 3:00–3:50pm ET — we do a 20-minute exec overview (Grace + Sean) then 30-minute technical breakout with Dev + engineers.
Option B: Tue, 4 May, 10:00–11:00am PT — same split.

If you confirm Friday at 3pm ET, we'll push an updated calendar invite and attach a one-pager for Tom so he sees the key ROI and security talking points up front.

Sean — can you prep a 10-slide exec one-pager?
Dev — can you plan to have the deeper demo environment ready if they choose the breakout?

Appreciate it — Grace

Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
On Mon, Apr 26, 2027 at 11:02 AM Alex Brown <alex.brown@skyrise.com> wrote:
From: Alex Brown <alex.brown@skyrise.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Lang <tom.lang@skyrise.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Need to move Thursday demo — VP travel conflict

Grace —

Thanks, Option A (Fri 30 Apr at 3pm ET) works best for Tom. A couple of small asks:
- Tom can only be on for the first 20 minutes (as noted) — he wants a concise ROI/security overview plus any answers on deployment and compliance.
- Please keep the executive materials tight — one-pager would be ideal.
- If you can share the deck and agenda beforehand, Tom will scan them during transit.

Could you also add Marissa from your leadership team to the invite? She'll be useful if there are questions about SLAs / enterprise terms.

I'll wait for the updated invite and materials.

Cheers,
Alex
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Alex Brown <alex.brown@skyrise.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need to move Thursday demo — VP travel conflict

Alex — looping Marissa and confirming we can run a stacked session: 20-minute exec overview (Grace + Sean + Marissa) then a technical deep-dive with Dev & engineers. We will: 
- Keep the exec slot to 20 minutes and focus on ROI, deployment patterns, and compliance highlights.
- Deliver the full demo afterward for the technical audience; separate Zoom breakout link will be provided.

Attachments: redwood-exec-onepager.pdf (exec summary), demo-agenda-20270430.pdf (minute-by-minute plan), mvp-demo-deck.pptx (full deck).

Sean — attached is a slightly condensed one-pager; feel free to flag edits.
Dev — will you confirm environment readiness by EOD today?

Thanks all — I'll send the updated calendar invite to lock time.

Best,
Grace

Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Alex / Tom — confirmed. I've created a new calendar invite for:
Fri, 30 Apr 2027 — 3:00–3:50pm ET
Agenda: 3:00–3:20pm — Exec overview (Grace, Sean, Marissa)
3:20–3:50pm — Technical demo & Q&A (Dev + engineers; separate breakout link after 3:20)

Attachments included again for ease: redwood-exec-onepager.pdf, demo-agenda-20270430.pdf, mvp-demo-deck.pptx
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/98765
Calendar: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/6a2b-demo-skyrise-20270430

If Tom prefers to join only the first 15 minutes, no problem — we'll keep the opening tight. See you Friday.

Best regards,
